primaryTextRead.text: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K — Joiarib
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list, Joiarib subsection, lines 4302–4310; treats Joiarib as priestly family name, including a return-period head; it does not specifically identify the first lot in 1 Chronicles 24:7.
